cues: The MAC address is burned into the network card and never changes; switches use it inside one network.
The IP address is logical and changes when you move to a new network; routers use it to cross networks.
text: And keep two addresses apart. The MAC address is burned into the network card and never changes; switches use it inside one network. The IP address is logical and changes when you move to a new network; routers use it to cross networks.
